authority.source: owner ruling 2026-10-02 (wave 2026-10-02d row BV): three template categories - Templates, Kits, Community packs; a community pack is finished, installed and used at once and cannot be modified; the community makes and shares them; a shared pack passes automatic checks (validate, bench, no outside network calls) and a NoaCG admin's approval before anyone else sees it; NoaCG seeds the shelf first. Owner direction 2026-10-08 (wave 2026-10-08 row K): community packs live in the template wizard, and the submit door is in the wizard or Home, not Playout
